deployedImage.confirmedBy: User-provided docker inspect output from vault, container doodles

knownDefects.detail: samsy/fury-ribbons is in both master manifests but its manifest and entrypoint are absent from the pinned archive; hosted manifest returns 404.
app/server.coffee labels uncompressed shell SVG files as gzip. The HTTP regression is marked as an expected failure.
A missing .js URL returns plain HTML with a gzip header. The HTTP regression is marked as an expected failure.
A rapid thumbnail hover play/pause can cause an unhandled AbortError. Only the specific observed cancellation message is allowed and annotated by the browser tests.

testLimitations: Headless Firefox in the pinned Linux runner could not create a WebGL context for OITNB. The cross-browser canvas test uses the self-contained Canvas 2D Neon Bubbles doodle. WebGL draw calls and pointer interaction are checked in Chromium with Box Physics; real-device GPU checks remain a release requirement.

Muscular Hydrostats references an external sketch.js URL despite including a local copy. The private test network deliberately does not provide the external script. Its HTML entrypoint is inventoried, but it is not used as an offline rendering smoke test.
